text: The type 'PathP (λ i → P i) a b' in Cubical Agda is equivalent to (in Book HoTT notation):
choices: transport (λ i → P i) a ≡ b — a heterogeneous path
explanation: PathP P a b is a heterogeneous path: a path from a : P i0 to b : P i1 lying over the path i↦P(i). Equivalent to transport along the path of types equals the target: subst P (λ i → ...) a ≡ b.
